RimMandrake.Inhabited.SecurityProfileDef.label: Cartel gate posture
RimMandrake.Inhabited.SecurityProfileDef.description: Nothing leaves a Hutt's seat that has not been paid for, and the gate is where the ledger is checked. Most leavers are searched; a guest of the lord is waved through, and knows it.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.SecurityProfileDef.label: Enclave gate posture
RimMandrake.Inhabited.SecurityProfileDef.description: The enclave has no goods it values enough to search a visitor for. It watches the fuel and the water, and it watches whether anyone leaves wearing a restraining bolt they did not arrive with.

RimMandrake.Inhabited.SecurityProfileDef.label: Compact gate posture
RimMandrake.Inhabited.SecurityProfileDef.description: The Compact sells water; it does not lose it. Every leaver is searched at the bastion, politely, by a warden who will not follow you past the gate and does not need to.
